snippet.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore Cyrodiil like never before in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered, available now on Xbox Series X|S, Game Pass, PlayStation 5 and PC. 

The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion™ Remastered modernizes the 2006 Game of the Year with all new stunning visuals and refined gameplay. Explore the vast landscape of Cyrodiil like never before and stop the forces of Oblivion from overtaking the land in one of the greatest RPGs ever from the award-winning Bethesda Game Studios. 

For more information about The Elder Scrolls, please visit https://elderscrolls.com or follow us on social media: 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/elderscrolls/  
Twitter/X: https://x.com/elderscrolls  
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrolls  
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrolls.bethesdastudios.com  
Discord: http://discord.gg/BethesdaStudios 

ESRB RATING: Mature with Violence, Blood and Gore and Sexual Themes.
